text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Whew! And that's the pigeon pose done! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: All right! I did it just like the article said, so I should have a "lovely body to make one's fated other swoon" in no ti—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: W-wait, what is this article?! "Exercises for a Beautiful Figure to Make Any Older Person Fall to Their Knees"?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Oh, this one's "Yoga to Make Your Legs Turn Heads"… Ooh, and this one is…

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I got it! If I do all these, Trainer will only have eyes for me!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'm home! Hey, Mayano, listen to what Prez to—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Mayano?! What happened? Why are you on the floor covered in sweat?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mayano Top Gun wore herself out trying to get a "hot bod."
